basic_details.job_title: NBRC Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: BRIC-National Brain Research Centre (NBRC) has one Research Associate-I position open under a DBT funded project on autism. Candidates need a Ph.D. in Science or Engineering, or an M.D./M.S. degree in any area of medicine, plus at least one first-author publication from their PhD work. The fellowship is Rs. 58,000 + HRA per month. Hard copies of the application must reach NBRC by 22 November 2026.

application_fee.details: The application fee is Rs. 200. It can be paid in either of these ways: | Demand Draft in favor of "Director, NBRC, Manesar" Online or via UPI to the "National Brain Research Centre" account

age_limit.details: Maximum 40 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of application.

qualification.details: Maximum 40 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of application. | Ph.D. in Science or Engineering, or an M.D./M.S. degree in any area of medicine Research interests in Development and Neuroscience A good academic record with at least one first-author publication arising from PhD work | Preferred: cell culture, primary culture, biochemistry, and molecular biology including CRISPR- or shRNA-mediated gene manipulation A valuable addition: animal handling, confocal microscopy, and lentivirus or Adeno Associated Virus-mediated genetic manipulation | See the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility wording for this post.

selection_process: A duly constituted Screening Committee shortlists the applications
and its decision is final. Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview.
Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not give a candidate any right to an interview call. The Centre will not entertain correspondence on shortlisting
and interim enquiries will not be attended to. No TA/DA is payable for attending the interview.
how_to_apply: Download the official notification (PDF). The application form is on its second and third pages.
Fill in the form, writing items 1 to 4 in capital letters, and paste a recent, signed passport size photograph.
Pay the application fee and attach the documents listed below.
Sign the declaration. Incorrect or misleading information makes your candidature liable to cancellation by NBRC at any time.
Mark the envelope "Application for Research Associate-I (Project)".
Send the hard copies by post to the address below.
The notice prints the same addressee with two versions of the address:
Advertisement page: The Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, Nainwal Mode, Gurugram-122052 (Haryana)
Application form instructions: The Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, NH-8, Manesar-122052, Distt Gurugram, Haryana
Self-attested copies of certificates of qualification and experience
Attested category certificate for SC, ST or Physically challenged candidates
An application without self-attested certificates shall summarily stand rejected without any intimation. Incomplete applications are also summarily rejected without any reason being given.

content_sections.heading: About NBRC
content_sections.text: National Brain Research Centre is a Deemed University at Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana. This position belongs to the DBT funded project "Role of Pax6(+) cortical progenitors in the etiology of Autism Spectrum Disorder". The Project Investigator is Dr. Dhananjay Huilgol of BRIC-NBRC.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A duly constituted Screening Committee shortlists the applications, and its decision is final. Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not give a candidate any right to an interview call. The Centre will not entertain correspondence on shortlisting, and interim enquiries will not be attended to. No TA/DA is payable for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure is one year, renewable for two more years upon successful review of performance. The post is co-terminus with the project. The job contract is regulated by the terms of the project and the prevailing rules and procedure followed at NBRC. Accommodation may be provided as per the rules of NBRC, subject to availability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NBRC Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification (PDF) . The application form is on its second and third pages. Fill in the form, writing items 1 to 4 in capital letters, and paste a recent, signed passport size photograph. Pay the application fee and attach the documents listed below. Sign the declaration. Incorrect or misleading information makes your candidature liable to cancellation by NBRC at any time. Mark the envelope "Application for Research Associate-I (Project)". Send the hard copies by post to the address below. The notice prints the same addressee with two versions of the address: Duly filled in application form Detailed CV Self-attested copies of certificates of qualification and experience Attested category certificate for SC, ST or Physically challenged candidates An application without self-attested certificates shall summarily stand rejected without any intimation. Incomplete applications are also summarily rejected without any reason being given.

faq.question: Q1. Is a publication compulsory for the NBRC Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Yes. The essential qualification includes at least one first-author publication arising from the candidate's PhD work.

faq.question: Q2. Can M.D. or M.S. degree holders apply?
faq.answer: Yes. An M.D./M.S. degree in any area of medicine is accepted, along with research interests in Development and Neuroscience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total monthly fellowship?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 58,000 plus HRA per month, and no other allowances apply.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It runs for one year and can be renewed for two more years after a successful performance review. It cannot outlast the project, as the post is co-terminus with it.

faq.question: Q5. What should be written on the envelope?
Q6. Which experience will be preferred?
faq.answer: Preference goes to candidates with experience in cell culture, primary culture, biochemistry, and molecular biology including CRISPR- or shRNA-mediated gene manipulation.

faq.question: Q7. Can the fee be paid by UPI?
faq.answer: Yes. The Rs. 200 fee can be paid online or via UPI to the National Brain Research Centre account at the IMT Manesar branch, or by Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q8. Will NBRC pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be payable to candidates attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is accommodation available?
faq.answer: It may be provided as per NBRC rules, subject to availability.
